svg.aria-label: The last 28 days of contributions drawn as a panoramic dental radiograph, one tooth per day: 8,611 contributions, busiest day 15 Nov with 2,878. Busier days show more dental work, from a small filling up to a crown and root filling; the busiest day is an implant.
svg.text: PANORAMIC · LAST 28 DAYS · ONE TOOTH PER DAY
one tooth per day, 17 → 27 then 37 → 47 · no days off
filling 1–90 · large filling 91–109 · root filling 110–193 · crown 194+ (contributions a day)
implant = busiest day, 15 Nov (2,878). the tooth did not survive.
